title: Increase table limit from 500 to 1000 in Fabric platform management and related components
summary: The maximum number of tables in the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring app goes up from 500 to 1000. This affects Fabric Platform Mgt, Fabric Config Package Mgt and the Fabric Platform Tables page, and tests were updated to match.
key_points: Changes in Fabric Platform Mgt, Fabric Config Package Mgt and the Fabric Platform Tables page
Test expectations updated for the new limit
